name: Runner Extras - AllObj virtual table
brief: Proves the AllObj system virtual table (2000000038) reports objects that exist in the app under test.
description: The AllObj metatable is parsed out of the System Application package, so it exists — but it has no data provider behind it and therefore zero rows. Every AllObj.Get(...) returns false for every object id, including objects the runner just compiled itself. Real BC answers truthfully. AL that gates on object existence via AllObj (a common and legitimate pattern) therefore takes its not-found branch unconditionally: Pageworks raises 'reportNotFound: Report N does not exist or you do not have permission to read it' for 13 tests, 12 of them for its OWN source-compiled reports. This suite pins the fix at the AL surface that actually matters — Get by (type, id), a filtered iteration, and the negative case for an id that genuinely does not exist, so a provider that simply answers true to everything fails here.
